auditor_value: Proof: R_max = u²/g at θ = 45° (sin 2θ = 1); H at 45° = u² sin²45°/(2g) = u²/(4g); hence R_max = 4H.
notes: All three equations follow: sin 90° = 1; sin²45° = 1/2 so H = u²/(4g); 4H = u²/g = R_max. The mistake entry reproduces its claim (dropping the 2 gives H = u²/(2g), 4H = 2u²/g, twice the range).
